name: Valentine's Rush
source:
To high school freshman Kenny Carter, life is balancing his mom’s high expectations with his favorite video game. So it’s mostly slow-paced, uninteresting, and in his room. But after the arrival of his old family friend, Paige, who proclaims herself his new girlfriend, Kenny finds that time is flying faster than he’s ever known. And wait, Valentine’s Day is coming up?! Will Kenny be able to keep up?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31389]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
对于高中新生肯尼卡特来说，生活就是在他妈妈的高期望和他最喜欢的电子游戏之间取得平衡。所以大部分都是慢节奏、无趣的，而且是在他的房间里。但在他的老朋友佩奇到来并自称是他的新女友后，肯尼发现时间过得比他想象的要快。等等，情人节快到了？！肯尼能跟上吗？

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31389]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
